brief_description: FastWan 2.2-I2V-A14B provided by FastVideo, generating videos in a fast speed.
detailed_description: FastWan generates video only in 8 denoising steps. It supports an image and prompt pair input

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Positive text prompt. Cannot exceed 2500 characters

parameters.name: path_input_image
parameters.description:
Support image URL. 
Supported image formats include.jpg / .jpeg / .png
The image file size cannot exceed 10MB, andthe width and height dimensions of the image shall not be less than 300px, and the aspect ratio of the image should be between 1:2.5 ~ 2.5:1
